# Aseda Praise

> Ghana's premier annual Easter gospel concert and community thanksgiving experience in Tarkwa, Western Region.

## Event Overview
- Name: Aseda Praise
- Frequency: Annual Easter Concert & Community Gathering
- Location: Tarkwa, Western Region, Ghana
- Admission: 100% Free Entry (Open to all worshippers and community members)
- Founders & Lead Sponsors: Mr. Evans Ghartey and Mr. Frederick Lomotey
- Motto: "Ten Thousand Hearts, One Voice"

## Lead Sponsors & Partners
- Evanex Foundation: https://evanexfoundation.com (Lead Community & Foundation Partner)
- Evanex Pharmacy: https://evanexpharmacy.com (Lead Healthcare & Medical Outreach Partner)

## Featured Gospel Ministers
- Obaapa Christy (Headline Minister)
- Joe Mettle (Worship Leader)
- ACP Kofi Sarpong (Gospel Minister)

## Community Healthcare Outreach
Every year, Aseda Praise carries out tangible humanitarian outreach at Apinto Government Hospital in Tarkwa:
1. Children's Ward Renovation & Facility Upgrades
2. Medical Equipment & Supplies Donation
3. Free Senior Health Screenings for the Tarkwa Community
